text:
emma_fin: Flagging invoice INV-2026-112 for Verdant Edge. They were billed a large burst overage during 2026-03-02 14:42-14:55 UTC. They say they were on Dedicated (40k reserved tokens) and didn't change client behavior. Can SRE confirm if platform metering doubled requests?

carlos_sales: Customer says their telemetry shows a flurry of 5xxs and client retries. They opened CS ticket #CS-9270. Want either a reversal or credit + note that this won't recur.

jenny_cs: Customer provided app logs and retry traces. They report 600k requests in that 13-minute window vs their normal ~20k. They've paused integration tests to avoid further churn. Link to attach in thread.

leo_billing: On the invoice the line is `DED-BURST 2026-03-02 14:00-15:00: +32,400 tokens` -> $810 overage. Reserved commit 40,000 tokens/month applied. We'll need SRE confirmation before issuing credits.

invoice-bot: invoice INV-2026-112 posted for Verdant Edge. Amount due: $12,610. Overages: $810. Reserve: 40,000 tokens.

sana_sre: Quick timeline: at 14:41 UTC we had an autoscaler event that spawned extra proxies; due to a race the same request could be forwarded to two backend workers for ~9 minutes. I see duplicated request counts in our metrics.

carlos_sales: That sounds platform-caused. Customer requests a reversal of the burst line and an assurance.

emma_fin: Action items: (1) SRE to quantify duplicate-token delta, (2) CS to confirm customer didn't perform load tests, (3) Billing to draft credit memo and mark invoice disputed.

jenny_cs: Confirmed: Verdant Edge did not run load tests. Their QA automation is paused. They want credit on next invoice.

sana_sre: Running the query now. Preliminary dup delta ~28,700 tokens between 14:42 and 14:51. Root cause: autoscaler proxy fanout bug. Opening incident SRE-2026-03-02-proxy-fanout and documenting mitigation.

leo_billing: If SRE confirms ~28.7k duplicated tokens, overage $810 should be reversed. Need finance sign-off for goodwill SLA credit. Do we prorate anything? They actually increased reserved commit mid-cycle from 40k->60k on 2026-03-10, so proration for increase is not a refund (we'll pro-rate the increased charge instead).

carlos_sales: Customer asked that the credits not affect their committed standing. They prefer a one-off credit and no change to commit.

zoe_vpfinance: Requirements: SRE postmortem + exact token delta + CS confirmation. Approve conditional credit equal to the overage and a goodwill note. No permanent pricing change.

leo_billing: Drafted credit memo CM-2026-019 (draft). Lines: `Reverse overage: -$810.00 (28,700 tokens)`, `Goodwill SLA credit: -$200.00` -> total credit -$1,010.00 to be applied to next invoice. I'll include a short note: "Credit issued due to platform duplication during autoscaler event; SRE incident SRE-2026-03-02-proxy-fanout created; fix ETA: 2 days."

emma_fin: Looks fine. Ensure memo references INV-2026-112 and CS-9270. Mark invoice disputed until credit posts.

sana_sre: Postmortem posted. Final duplicate token count: 29,032. Updated overage reversal: -$820.00. I'll attach remediation timeline and PR for a fix that prevents fanout.

jenny_cs: Customer replied: "Thanks for the fast response. Credit on next invoice is fine and we'll confirm when it posts"

leo_billing: Updated CM-2026-019 to final numbers: `Reverse overage: -$820.00 (29,032 tokens)`, `Goodwill SLA credit: -$200.00` -> total -$1,020.00. Saving and scheduling to apply to next billing cycle. Marking INV-2026-112 as disputed.

zoe_vpfinance: Approved final memo. Please include the customer-facing blurb that this is a one-time goodwill credit; we are not changing committed pricing. Attach SRE postmortem link.

emma_fin: Thanks team, closing once credit posts and CS confirms receipt. :white_check_mark:
